dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple high-contrast, light-colored 'O' and 'C' shaped perimeters with sharp gradient transitions from dark exterior pelt to light ring edges, most prominent on the upper dorsal and cervical regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid light-intensity pixel clusters along the mid-lateral flank, where individual annuli converge into an amorphous high-luminance region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary triad of prominent macro-annuli on the upper dorsal surface forms an obtuse scalene triangle, while a secondary cluster of four smaller annuli creates a trapezoidal configuration near the cervical fold.

other_distinctive_markers: A highly concentrated, interlocking network of micro-annuli forming a dense honeycomb-like texture on the anterior cervical region.
